note: Machine register of known limitations carried by the M0-D closeout. Every entry stays OPEN until a separate, Receipt-backed Owner Decision or a reviewed successor change closes it. The register grants no authorization (contract section 11).

entries.title: OPEN_BY_OD-5: general M1 user_confirmed is self-attested
entries.statement: A bound Agent can write authority=user_explicit through the public clued_record_mutate by sending user_confirmed=true, bypassing Candidate, promotion and the Native token.
entries.consequence: Agent authority is confined only on the Information Flow path; every PASS label carries that qualifier. Such Records are Agent-authored and excluded from the default policy (E2E-12).
entries.successor: A separate Owner decision on OD-5 (tighten general M1 writes); E2E-11 expectation then flips to rejection.

entries.title: Confirmation proves a session, not a person
entries.statement: The two-step token proves a recently authenticated Native account session that performed a two-step confirmation; it cannot prove that a person rather than a script holding the session pressed the button.
entries.consequence: Contract text says human only in this sense.
entries.successor: Stronger user-presence evidence (for example WebAuthn step-up) in a later contract.

entries.title: lineage_stale and evidence_withdrawn are MSCP-only
entries.statement: The flags affect MSCP compilation only; the Record still reads CURRENT/active in Currentness, search, export and the five views until it is re-promoted, re-sourced or closed.
entries.consequence: Readers outside the Context Compiler do not see the invalidation.
entries.successor: A reviewed propagation of invalidation to other read surfaces.

entries.title: No Native-marker backfill
entries.statement: Records written before S3 (and legacy null-writer Records) read human_confirmed=false until re-confirmed.
entries.consequence: Older Native Records are excluded from default packs until re-confirmed through a Native write.
entries.successor: An Owner-authorized, Receipt-backed re-confirmation flow.

entries.title: Binding-driven denial of service under OD-5
entries.statement: A Binding can shadow State/Task through Events (a shadow needs a carrier transition) or edit/supersede the approving Decision, excluding pack items or disabling a policy until a new Native acceptance.
entries.consequence: Denial of service, not a policy change.
entries.successor: OD-5 decision; per-policy Decision write protection.

entries.title: Different confirmation strength: /v1/records marker vs two-step promotion
entries.statement: A direct Native /v1/records write gets a Native marker without a two-step token; promotion requires the two-step token.
entries.consequence: Both read human_confirmed=true in packs although their confirmation strength differs.
entries.successor: A marker strength field or a two-step option for direct Native writes.

entries.title: Contract errata carried from S1/S2
entries.statement: The implementation differs in wording from frozen v0.1: storage_ref=intake:{submission_id} (contract: candidate_id); idempotency_key lives on the submission row; knowledge_candidates has no payload column (assertion + sources); private RPC names are intake_submit_core_v1 / knowledge_propose_core_v1; the intake Evidence hash covers the canonical jsonb text of the segment.
entries.consequence: The frozen v0.1 text cannot be edited; readers must apply these errata.
entries.successor: An errata or v0.2 Decision after closeout (not in S6).

entries.title: Candidate expiry is lazy (no sweep)
entries.source: S3 D10; S5 D5; Owner deferral in S6
entries.statement: Expiry is applied only inside promotion; expired-but-pending rows still list as pending. A system sweep needs a non-additive widening of candidate_transitions.actor and a scheduler that does not exist.
entries.consequence: Pending lists can include candidates past expires_at; promotion fails closed on them.
entries.successor: Post-M0-D retention slice (design in the S6 plan section 6).

entries.title: Pack manifest retention is unbounded
entries.source: S4 D34, D27, D12; Owner deferral in S6
entries.statement: context_pack_manifests rows are never garbage-collected. A budget-refused pack leaves a manifest that revalidates VALID with token_budget_verified=false, and a context:read Binding causes Receipt-less manifest inserts.
entries.consequence: Derived, non-Canonical rows grow without bound.
entries.successor: Post-M0-D manifest GC (design in the S6 plan section 6).

entries.title: auth_time semantics verified on local GoTrue only
entries.statement: The 15-minute re-authentication rule reads amr timestamps; local GoTrue v2.195.0 tokens were exercised for real in S6, production GoTrue amr behaviour is unverified.
entries.consequence: Production behaviour must be read back before any authorized apply.
entries.successor: Production read-back under a separately authorized apply.

entries.title: Token-burn limits
entries.statement: Failures before the receipt core (malformed transport, authentication) do not burn a live confirmation token.
entries.consequence: A token survives some refused requests until its TTL.
entries.successor: None planned; disclosed.

entries.title: Delegated OAuth writes
entries.statement: Delegated-OAuth decision supersede writes no Native marker; a delegated-OAuth JWT on Native REST passes the Worker and is refused by the database guard.
entries.consequence: Delegated OAuth never yields human_confirmed=true.
entries.successor: None planned; disclosed.

entries.title: Token budget enforced only on the Worker path
entries.statement: Direct PostgREST compiles are not measured (measurement not_measured); the budget is enforced by the Worker.
entries.consequence: A direct PostgREST caller can obtain an unmeasured pack.
entries.successor: Server-side token counting if the tokenizer is accepted.

entries.title: Tokenizer offline_target; production bundle and CPU unverified
entries.source: contract 6.2; S4 release impact; S6 bundle observation
entries.statement: Token counts are labelled tokenizer_status=offline_target. Bundle size and startup/first-pack CPU were observed only locally in workerd.
entries.consequence: The Cloudflare plan-limit check and a production CPU observation are a precondition of any authorized production apply (Owner decision).
entries.successor: Tokenizer acceptance; production limits check before apply.

entries.title: Evidence withdrawal is terminal
entries.statement: A withdrawn Evidence cannot be reinstated in MVP-0.
entries.consequence: Re-sourcing needs a new Evidence and a Receipt-backed Record write.
entries.successor: A reinstatement transition in a later contract.

entries.title: Proactive staling coverage
entries.statement: Currentness-only changes, Binding time expiry, approving-Decision edits and other candidate transitions are caught on demand at compile/revalidation, not proactively; proactive staling uses SKIP LOCKED and can skip a locked manifest.
entries.consequence: A manifest can read stale=false until revalidated; revalidation is the backstop.
entries.successor: None planned; disclosed.

entries.title: Maintenance-DML lock order
entries.statement: Maintenance writes must take currentness_user_lock first; the wrapper does, raw DML does not.
entries.consequence: Raw maintenance DML can deadlock with withdrawal fan-out.
entries.successor: Runbook rule; no code change.

entries.title: Direct M1 writes can cite withdrawn Evidence
entries.statement: A direct M1 write citing a withdrawn Evidence commits; it is flagged at write time in record_evidence_status.
entries.consequence: Such Records are excluded from compiles but remain CURRENT elsewhere (see L03).
entries.successor: None planned; disclosed.

entries.title: Withdrawal scan without index; uncapped fan-out
entries.statement: The withdrawal fan-out scans source_refs without a dedicated index and is uncapped (echoed lists are capped at 100).
entries.consequence: Large accounts may see slow withdrawals.
entries.successor: An additive index once production volumes are known.

entries.title: Transient PROJECTION_REQUIRED has no DB test
entries.statement: The PROJECTION_REQUIRED revalidation outcome is not covered by a database test.
entries.consequence: Covered only by code review.
entries.successor: A targeted test in a later slice.

entries.title: historical freshness can be authoritative; notes at any lifecycle
entries.statement: A pack under explicit historical freshness can be authoritative=true, and notes are admitted regardless of lifecycle under historical mode.
entries.consequence: Consumers must read the freshness block.
entries.successor: None planned; disclosed.

entries.title: Candidate visibility for a Binding
entries.statement: A Binding sees its own candidates and native_ui candidates in packs that allow candidate tiers.
entries.consequence: Native candidates can reach an Agent under an explicit candidate-tier policy.
entries.successor: None planned; disclosed.

entries.title: Payload-cap backstop semantics
entries.statement: The database payload cap is a backstop behind the Worker's 1 MiB body limit and reports a generic error.
entries.consequence: Oversized payloads are refused with a coarse error.
entries.successor: None planned; disclosed.

entries.title: MCP reachable in practice only with Binding tokens
entries.statement: Legacy OAuth tokens are rejected on the Information Flow MCP tools; delegated OAuth dispatches to the same Binding entries.
entries.consequence: Agents must hold a Binding.
entries.successor: None planned; disclosed.

entries.title: S6 harness residuals
entries.statement: Bindings are minted and reduced through the v12 RPCs over PostgREST with a fixture issuer row; the Worker consent API, the delegated-OAuth scopedApi/checkBinding wrapper and KV are not exercised (successor L27); issue+consume in one request is structurally impossible over HTTP (DB-level test); the kill is a SIGKILL of the workerd host group after the committed upstream response; E2E-08 restarts db/PostgREST/GoTrue/Kong and a new process; token expiry uses the real clock; the 15-minute re-authentication case stays DB-level; the harness Worker config omits global_fetch_strictly_public; the harness Worker entry is the continuity handler, not the full vinext entry; E2E-05 reduction is a PostgREST call with the owner JWT; E2E-15(b) needs a DB fixture re-point; the observer is read-only and used only for internal state with no read route; E2E-10 reads the Record body through the Native export route.
entries.consequence: Evidence is local transport qualification with these disclosed substitutions.
entries.successor: None planned; disclosed.

entries.title: Production state
entries.statement: S1 was applied to clued-prod per PR #307. The Owner authorized that apply retroactively in Canonical Decision 7040b127-2a42-4ff6-ba46-060a594a9c1d (Receipt cef0f0dd-c89e-4eac-b805-18c0816b4449), Agent-written and disclosed under OPEN_BY_OD-5, quoting the Owner: “补记授权，结论保持“本地验证” (推荐)”. S2-S5 were not applied; the production release gate blocks releases. No full apply has been read back.
entries.consequence: Every verdict keeps _LOCAL_QUALIFIED; B08 is scoped to the S6 qualification runs as the Decision states; the Task criterion 'truly connected to the Canonical Store' is not met.
entries.successor: A separately authorized production apply with backup and read-back.

authorization.quoted_owner_confirmation: 补记授权，结论保持“本地验证” (推荐)

entries.title: Delegated-OAuth end-to-end run is a post-M0-D successor
entries.source: B09 round 1 F08; S6 plan 14 items 2, 19, 25
entries.statement: The S6 harness mints and reduces Bindings through the v12 RPCs and serves /mcp from the continuity handler; the production MCP entry path (Worker consent API, delegated-OAuth scopedApi/checkBinding wrapper, KV) is not exercised end to end.
entries.consequence: No production claim may rest on the S6 run for the delegated-OAuth entry path.
entries.successor: Before any production claim: a delegated-OAuth end-to-end run through the Worker consent API and the scopedApi/checkBinding wrapper, including a scope reduction through the consent API.

entries.title: S1 production apply has no pre-apply backup or read-back record
entries.source: B09 round 1 F01; contract 3 OD-4; Decision 7040b127-2a42-4ff6-ba46-060a594a9c1d
entries.statement: OD-4 requires every clued-prod apply to have its own pre-apply backup and read-back. For the S1 apply (PR #307) neither a pre-apply backup nor a read-back record exists; the authorization was recorded retroactively.
entries.consequence: The S1 production state is unverified; verdicts keep _LOCAL_QUALIFIED and B08 excludes the S1 apply as a referenced exception.
entries.successor: A separately authorized read-back of the S1 objects in clued-prod (and a backup before any further apply).

authorization.quoted_owner_confirmation: 补记授权，结论保持“本地验证” (推荐)
